item.subject: science
item.stem:
Aditya heats dry sugar crystals in the boiling tube shown in the diagram. Water droplets collect on the cooler upper wall, and a black solid remains at the bottom.

What does this show about sugar?

options.A: Sugar is a compound: heating decomposes it into carbon and water, so it contains more than one element.
options.B: Sugar is an element, because it began as one white solid in the tube.
options.C: The water droplets came from moist room air, not from the dry sugar.
options.D: Sugar was already a ready mixture of charcoal and water packed inside the crystals.
